title: Oxidative stress induces chromosomal instability through replication stress in fibroblasts from aged mice
model: Primary early-passage fibroblasts from young and aged C57BL/6J mice; no engineered BUB1B genotype
observation: At 5 mM NAC, aged-cell live imaging showed fewer segregation errors and reduced replication-stress readouts; young-cell response differed.
contrary_or_limit: Related aging model, not MVA. Millimolar culture exposure; human unbound tissue exposure not established. NAC plus MitoQ/UMK57 did not uniformly add benefit.
evidence_access: full text, Fig4/Fig6 and drug-treatment methods inspected

title: Contribution of BubR1 to oxidative stress-induced aneuploidy in p53-deficient cells
model: Human MRC5 fibroblasts under chemical oxidative stress; p53/BubR1 knockdown experiments
observation: NAC prevented oxidant-associated loss of BubR1/Mad2 expression; the paper demonstrates context-dependent p53/BubR1 effects on polyploidy.
contrary_or_limit: No inherited BUB1B-mutant rescue. Protein preservation is not corrected segregation. p53 modulation must not be inferred to be therapeutic.
evidence_access: full text, results and Fig1-3 inspected
